name: 30338 · Atlanta, GA
findings: ZIP 30338 (Atlanta) has 232 nonprofit organizations. 118 of them (51%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 102 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 30338 (Atlanta) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 30338 (Atlanta) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.3 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 70 organizations here; 29% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are public events so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 14 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 14 organizations here; 29% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Few arts and cultural organizations list membership
observations.text: 1 arts and cultural organization here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 6 would.

confidence.text: Based on 6 organizations here; 29% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for groups to join through arts and cultural groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.text: 10 education organizations here list volunteering, compared with about 5 in similar places of this size.
